content_zh:
在这些天里，泉镜花与夏风瑶可算是吃够了苦头。
其实如果只是辛苦的话两人倒也无所谓，毕竟夏风瑶之前是练习散打，比起这个只会更加辛苦，锻炼对于她只是平常事。
而镜花虽然体弱，但是毕竟本质是男人，不至于吃不了苦。
但最大的问题不是辛苦，而是尴尬。
让英姿飒爽的夏风瑶去跳柔和的舞蹈，让性情清冷的泉镜花去搔首弄姿。
两人都只觉得十分难受，越学越觉得尴尬。
到最后，两人的动作无比标准，但秦老师却是完全看不下去了，只觉得无比的难受。
因此当长假结束，两人又得上学的时候，两人内心深处都禁不住感到了一种解脱的喜悦。
“啊，第一次觉得上学好棒啊。”走在前往学校的路上，夏风瑶不禁感叹起来。“比起散打难受多了，我宁愿去跑一万米也不想做那些动作了。”
“我可跑不了一万米。”镜花摇了摇头。“但我也不想跳舞。”
“对了，我已经不学散打了，已经告诉了散打的教练了，教练很生气。”夏风瑶说道。
“那当然了，他不是想培养一个女子散打冠军，又养眼又涨人气。你就这么走了，他肯定生气啊！”泉镜花倒是知道，夏风瑶本身的身体素质就不错，又喜欢锻炼，散打也学的不错，尤其是在没有多少女生会学习的散打科目，拿大奖也并非不可能。
“是啊，他还劝了我，希望我去参加市内的大赛，不过我还是放弃了，反正我学散打的目的又不是拿奖杯。”
“也是呢，锻炼身体最重要。”
“也不是为了锻炼身体，算了。”夏风瑶仿佛想要解释什么，但是看着镜花却没有说下去。
“那你的父母怎么看？”镜花开口问道。
听到镜花的问话，夏风瑶脸色一瞬间变得铁青。
“难道他们不同意？”泉镜花不禁觉得难办了，如果父母不同意的话，不管是想要学习舞蹈还是唱歌，之后的活动都难以进行下去。
夏风瑶的的脸色变得更加难看。
“不，他们同意了，而且还很高兴。”

“那为什么你脸色这么难看？”泉镜花疑惑不解。
夏风瑶还有些气鼓鼓的，嘟着嘴道：“什么意思嘛！什么女儿长这么大，终于开窍了。什么终于不学什么垃圾武术了，终于知道要学女孩子该学的东西了。就这么瞧不起武术啊。”
“嗯，伯父伯母的意见也不是没有道理啊。武术在现代社会本来就用处不大，而且你毕竟是女孩子，学了武术也没有什么用。”
“只不过是学跳舞学音乐，有那么值得高兴的么？尤其是我妈，说什么一下子感觉身材都变好了，变得顺眼了。我这才刚学，什么都没有学会好么！”夏风瑶还是有些难以接受。
泉镜花却有些理解，毕竟为人父母的，希望自己的女儿更可爱更有人喜欢，而不是学了武术变得多么能打。
夏风瑶学武勤奋，对于外人来说是了不起的事情，对于父母来说就未必会高兴了。
跳舞音乐这些东西，就算不论身材气质的变化，也会让女孩子显得更加有魅力，夏风瑶的父母当然乐于接受了。
不过，泉镜花心中明白，即使是别的东西，只要女儿真心喜欢，他们哪怕是不喜欢也会尽力接受的吧。想到他们明明不喜欢武术却还是送她去学了。
“从现在起，只有周末才有学习的时间，感觉好轻松啊！”夏风瑶感觉到十分的轻松愉快。
“很快你就知道，学校里还有各种作业让你做，一样很辛苦的。”
“做什么都不容易啊。”想到学校之中的生活，夏风瑶不禁感叹了起来。
两人走到了学校的门口，这是两人离家都比较近的一所初中，泉镜花选择这里只是因为离家比较近。一般的学生都是住宿，不过镜花需要照顾母亲就选择了办理离校。
当然，这也是镜花体质的特殊，如果选择住宿的话，镜花无法保证自己这个死宅不会在女生宿舍中干出什么骇人听闻的事件来。
但这也让更多的人以为泉镜花十分孤僻，毕竟是一个没有住校的学生，就显得很不合群。
想到高中恐怕就不会这么容易了，她心中也有些苦恼。到时候没有办法照顾安喵事小，万一在宿舍之中把持不住就完了。
学校门口却忽然有个女生叫住了夏风瑶。
“夏风瑶，你过来一下。”那个女生叫过去了夏风瑶，两人谈了起来。如果是其他人或许会觉得这是夏风瑶被欺负了。不过镜花知道，夏风瑶学过散打，在女生中的人缘也不错，不会有人欺负她也没人敢欺负她。

content_en:
In these days, Quan Jinghua and Xia Fengyao had suffered enough.
In fact, if it was just hard work, it wouldn't matter to the two of them. After all, Xia Fengyao had practiced Sanda before, so it would only be harder than this. Exercise was just a normal thing for her.
Although Kyoka is weak, she is still a man at heart, so she will not be unable to endure hardships.
But the biggest problem is not the hard work, but the embarrassment.
Let the heroic Xia Fengyao dance softly, and let the cold-tempered Quan Jinghua do some posing.
Both of them just felt very uncomfortable, and the more they learned, the more embarrassed they became.
In the end, the two people's movements were extremely standard, but Teacher Qin couldn't stand it anymore and only felt extremely uncomfortable.
So when the long vacation ended and the two of them had to go to school again, they couldn't help but feel a sense of relief deep in their hearts.
"Ah, it's the first time that I feel like going to school is great." Xia Fengyao couldn't help but sigh as she walked on the way to school. "It's much more uncomfortable than sparring. I'd rather run 10,000 meters than do those moves."
"I can't run ten thousand meters." Jinghua shook her head. "But I don't want to dance either."
"By the way, I no longer want to learn Sanda. I have already told the Sanda coach. The coach is very angry." Xia Fengyao said.
"Of course, he doesn't want to cultivate a women's Sanda champion who will be eye-catching and popular. If you just leave like this, he will definitely be angry!" Quan Jinghua knew that Xia Fengyao had good physical fitness and liked to exercise. She also learned Sanda well, especially in Sanda subjects that not many girls would learn. It is not impossible to win a grand prize.
"Yes, he also persuaded me to participate in the city's competition, but I still gave up. Anyway, my purpose of learning Sanda is not to win a trophy."
"That's right. Exercise is the most important thing."
"It's not for exercise, forget it." Xia Fengyao seemed to want to explain something, but looked at Jinghua but did not continue.
"What do your parents think?" Jinghua asked.
After hearing Jinghua's question, Xia Fengyao's face turned livid in an instant.
"Don't they agree?" Quan Jinghua couldn't help but feel that it was difficult. If her parents did not agree, whether she wanted to learn dancing or singing, it would be difficult to carry out subsequent activities.
Xia Fengyao's face became even more ugly.
"No, they agreed, and they were happy about it."
"Then why do you look so ugly?" Quan Jinghua was puzzled.
Xia Fengyao was still a little angry. She pouted and said, "What do you mean! Why is my daughter finally enlightened when she has grown so big? Why is she finally not learning rubbish martial arts? She finally knows how to learn what girls should learn. You look down on martial arts so much."
"Well, my uncle and aunt's opinions are not unreasonable. Martial arts is of little use in modern society, and you are a girl after all, so learning martial arts is of little use."
"It's just learning to dance and music. Is that worth being happy about? Especially my mother, she said that her figure suddenly got better and she became more pleasing to the eye. I just started learning, and I didn't learn anything!" Xia Fengyao still found it hard to accept.
Izumi Kyoka understands somewhat. After all, as a parent, she wants her daughter to be more cute and liked by others, not to become more capable after learning martial arts.
Xia Fengyao's diligence in learning martial arts is a great thing for outsiders, but it may not be happy for her parents.
Things like dancing music can make girls look more attractive regardless of changes in body shape and temperament. Of course Xia Fengyao's parents are happy to accept it.
However, Izumi Kyoka understands that even if it is something else, as long as her daughter really likes it, they will try their best to accept it even if they don't like it. Thinking that they clearly didn't like martial arts but still sent her to learn it.
"From now on, I only have time to study on weekends. It feels so relaxing!" XiaFeng Yao felt very relaxed and happy.
"Soon you will know that there are various assignments for you to do in school, which are also very hard."
"It's not easy to do anything." Xia Fengyao couldn't help but sigh when she thought of the life in school.
The two of them walked to the door of the school. This was a junior high school that was relatively close to their homes. Quan Jinghua chose this school just because it was relatively close to home. Most students stay in the dormitory, but Kyoka needed to take care of her mother, so she chose to leave school.
Of course, this is also the special nature of Jinghua's physique. If she chooses to stay, Jinghua cannot guarantee that she, a nerd, will not cause any appalling incidents in the girls' dormitory.
But this also made more people think that Quan Jinghua was very lonely. After all, she was a student who did not live on campus, so she seemed very unsociable.
Thinking that high school might not be so easy, she felt a little troubled. When the time comes, there will be no way to take care of An Miao. It will be over if she cannot control herself in the dormitory.
Suddenly, a girl called Xia Fengyao at the school gate.
"Xia Fengyao, come here." The girl called Xia Fengyao over, and the two started talking. If it were other people, they might think that Xia Fengyao was bullied. However, Jinghua knew that Xia Fengyao had learned Sanda and was very popular among girls. No one would bully her and no one would dare to bully her.
